page.overview:
Who is Cairlyn Nesolle?

Cairlyn Nesolle is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah., Cairlyn Nesolle}}

Cairlyn has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.
